Mango sticky rice 🥭🍚

INGREDIENTS 🛒
• 1 cup glutinous rice
• 1 can coconut milk
• 3 tbsp sugar
• 1/2 tsp salt
• 2 ripe mangoes

STEPS 👩‍🍳
1️⃣ Soak the rice for 2 hours then steam for 25 minutes.
2️⃣ Warm the coconut milk with the sugar and salt.
3️⃣ Fold half the coconut mixture into the hot rice.
4️⃣ Serve with sliced mango and the rest of the sauce.

Follow @mangomania for more 🥭
